Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Security Guards (Unarmed) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Security Guards?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Security Guards (Unarmed) posts at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 20 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Security Guards (Unarmed) at TMC?
faq.answer: Tata Memorial Centre is recruiting for a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Security Guards (Unarmed).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Security Guards post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC or an equivalent certificate from the Armed Forces. Ex-servicemen with a minimum of 15 years of service discharged or retired within the last 3 years are also eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Security Guards (Unarmed) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Security Guards (Unarmed) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 23,868/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the TMC Security Guards recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Security Guards (Unarmed) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) office in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Security Guards (Unarmed) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is OS/VIZAG/26/28.
